runs.platform: Linux Wayland on the reference compositor
runs.hardware: 13th Gen Intel(R) Core(TM) i7-13620H (16 logical cores), 62 GiB RAM, Mesa Intel(R) Graphics (RPL-P), NVMe storage
exercised: #38: three active terminal tabs with bounded scrollback in real PTYs
#38: a live integrated Preview of the run's own output
#38: Preview origins, localhost included, that inherit neither workbench nor Host authority and reach the app only through validated bridge operations
runs.stop_condition: #38: a measurement the instrument cannot observe stops the run and is reported unknown, never counted as met
failures: #38: a measurement the instrument cannot observe stops the run and is reported unknown, never counted as met
cold_start_to_workbench_ready_seconds: this fixture has no workbench: its PROOF_READY marker precedes its first frame and every WebKit helper, so it is not a workbench-ready signal
idle_process_tree_pss_mib: this fixture has no idle state: its streams, PTYs and Preview start with the app, so no sample is an idle sample
worst_input_starvation_ms: this driver issues no input in a Wayland session, so no starvation interval is observed
journal_events_lost_across_crash: this fixture keeps no canonical store or journal for events to be lost from
installer_size_mib: nothing in this fixture packages an installer for any platform
the instrument cannot separate the Preview renderer from the workbench and Lead renderers, so the unattributed share is not attribution at the contract’s finest granularity
the Preview’s denials are self-reported through the fixture’s unauthenticated report endpoint; its label-and-origin validator is covered by the fixture’s own unit test rather than by this run
terminal input, tab switching and scrollback behaviour are not exercised; the run attests three active PTYs and their bounded output rings
workload_process_tree_pss_mib: the peak of 251 samples fell 0.621 s into the sampled window (0.01 s to 25.045 s), so where it fell is recorded with the figure rather than left to the reader
